content: Nvidia is in rough shape. As the hardware company scrambles to replace its CEO and co-founder, Jensen Huang, after a series of scandals, it seems the needs of lowly gamers aren’t high on the priority list. Earlier this year, the company ran into controversy over its ugly generative AI-fueled DLSS 5 technology. If you need more evidence that Nvidia is focused on cranking out chips for generative AI rather than supporting its gaming hardware, the company has failed to fix a bug reportedly capable of damaging users’ PCs by writing excessive amounts of data to solid-state drives (SSDs).
